name: COCO-Stuff: Dense Pixel Annotations for Things and Stuff
description: COCO-Stuff augments the Microsoft COCO dataset with pixel-level annotations for 91 stuff classes (e.g. sky, grass, water, pavement) alongside the original 80 thing classes, yielding complete dense scene coverage across 164,000 images. Developed by Caesar, Uijlings, and Ferrari, COCO-Stuff is a principal benchmark for semantic segmentation, panoptic segmentation, and scene layout understanding.
